units.source_text: 源氏大将回到二条院私邸，不往西殿，径赴自己室内，独自躺下。

en.t: General Genji returned to his private residence at Nijo-in, did not go to the west wing, but went straight to his own room and lay down alone.

units.source_text: 不能成眠，痛感人世之可厌。

en.t: Unable to fall asleep, he felt keenly how hateful the human world could be.

units.source_text: 只有皇太子之事，不能忘怀。

en.t: Only the matter of the Crown Prince would not leave his mind.

units.source_text: 他想：“父皇在世之时，特地封藤壶妃子为皇后，

en.t: He thought, “When my father the Emperor was alive, he deliberately raised Lady Fujitsubo to the rank of Empress,

units.source_text: 让她做皇太子的正式保护人。

en.t: making her the Crown Prince’s formal guardian.

units.source_text: 不料皇后不堪尘世之苦，出家为尼。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the Empress could not bear the sufferings of this dusty world and became a nun.

units.source_text: 今后恐不能再居皇后之位了。

en.t: From now on, she will probably no longer be able to remain in the position of Empress.

units.source_text: 我倘也摒弃皇太子而去，这便……”

en.t: If I too abandon the Crown Prince and go away, then that would be...”

units.source_text: 无限思虑，一直想到了天明。

en.t: Lost in endless thoughts, he kept thinking until dawn.

units.source_text: 忽念今后须为这出家人准备用品，

en.t: Suddenly he remembered that from now on he would need to prepare supplies for this person who had entered religious life,

units.source_text: 便命令从人赶速调度，务须于年内完成。

en.t: so he ordered his attendants to make arrangements quickly and be sure to finish within the year.

units.source_text: 王命妇随伴皇后一同出家，对此人亦须恳切慰问。

en.t: Omyobu had accompanied the Empress and taken vows with her, so she too had to be warmly comforted and visited.

units.source_text: 详细缕述此种事情，不免烦冗，故请从略。

en.t: To describe such matters in full detail would inevitably become tedious, so I will omit them here.

units.source_text: 惟此际亦有富有风韵的诗篇，一概从略，亦不免遗憾耳。

en.t: Yet there were also poems of rich elegance at this time, and it is regrettable to pass over them all.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后出家之后，源氏大将来访时少有顾虑，有时可与皇后直接面谈。

en.t: After Empress Fujitsubo became a nun, General Genji had fewer reservations when he came to visit, and at times he could speak with her directly.

units.source_text: 他对皇后的恋情，至今尚未完全忘怀。

en.t: His love for the Empress had still not been completely forgotten.

units.source_text: 但处此情况之下，当然无可奈何了。

en.t: But under these circumstances, of course, there was nothing that could be done.
